name: PT MDTV Media Technologies Tbk
summary: PT MDTV Media Technologies Tbk, through its subsidiaries, engages in the media industry business in Indonesia. It offers artist management, television broadcasting, production houses, and digital media. The company also provides management consulting and financial services; and non-insurance and pension fund related services, and professional, scientific, and technical services. PT MDTV Media Technologies Tbk was formerly known as PT Net Visi Media Tbk and changed its name to PT MDTV Media Technologies Tbk in November 2024. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. PT MDTV Media Technologies Tbk is a subsidiary of PT MD Entertainment Tbk.
